description: The 2020 Chevrolet Tahoe LT Texas Edition Package is a specific trim level that bundles a number of popular features into one option. It's essentially an upgrade to the standard LT trim, adding more comfort, convenience, and safety features that were otherwise optional.What's in the Texas Edition Package?The Texas Edition Package builds on the standard LT trim with several key additions. The package typically includes:Luxury & Convenience: Power-folding third-row 60/40 split-bench seats, power-release second-row seats, a hands-free power liftgate, a heated steering wheel, and heated second-row outboard seats.Safety & Driver Assistance: Features like Front and Rear Park Assist, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert are included to help with awareness and maneuvering.Exterior: The package is often distinguished by a unique Texas Edition emblem.Technology: It may also include an extended subscription to SiriusXM Radio.Standard LT FeaturesEven without the Texas Edition, the 2020 Tahoe LT is well-equipped. Whether you're seeking a capable off-road companion or a luxurious family hauler, this Jeep delivers on all fronts.  Imagine the convenience of the Uconnect 8.4" touchscreen display, which provides seamless integration of your smartphone and access to a wealth of information and entertainment. The Trailer Tow Group IV package enhances the Grand Cherokee's versatility, allowing you to tow your toys or gear with confidence. And with the power sunroof, you can let the fresh air and sunshine in, creating an even more enjoyable driving experience.  Comfort and style are also hallmarks of the Grand Cherokee Limited. The premium leather-trimmed bucket seats, heated steering wheel, and heated front and rear seats ensure a relaxing and indulgent journey, no matter the destination. The power liftgate and rear load leveling suspension make loading and unloading a breeze, while the advanced safety features, including Rear Parking Sensors and Rear-View Auto-Dimming Mirror, provide added peace of mind.  As you embark on your next adventure, the 2015 Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited is ready to elevate your driving experience.
